title: Target-backed normative inc8 example blocked on published ref expansion
description: §8.2: every leaf event is a native gate after scheme expansion; §8.3: Every template gate MUST itself match a gates entry. A valid CC wrapper around the normative §16.3 inc8 object passes both CLIs and executes untargeted. VM --target on each of the three models refuses lift.const.i8 expansion: required ref library unpublished (bennett-vm-47t / ISA b-isa-spec-8r4). Publish normative lifted-row decompositions, library hash and stable expansion ordinals; keep the spec-example acceptance blocked rather than substituting the registers fixture.

title: VM rejects RFC 8785 small-exponent canonical numbers
description: Published §8.1 requires RFC 8785. The validator emits 1e-8 / 2e-8 / 2e-7 with ryu-js; VM run-program registers.bisa views --target rejects the valid canonical grid projection as noncanonical. Minimal independent reproduction retained by verification harness. No VM source inspected or changed. Need VM JCS ECMAScript number serializer.

title: Reference CLI target evaluation unavailable
description: §8.1: "Division by zero and a table index outside the array are load-time errors." Reference README run-program --target explicitly reports staged deliverable 9, so no schema/evaluation/hash acceptance oracle exists through that CLI. Need target validate/eval CLI and promotion of E outcomes; refusals cannot count as agreement.

title: Define import of probabilistic hardware errors and QEC models
description: North Star §7: "target-description format accepts imported models, converting units where they align ... otherwise importing them as new named resources." §8.1 defines epsilon as achieved approximation error; physical failure probabilities and QEC/factory formulas are not that metric. Need declared stochastic error/resource semantics and hierarchy/code-distance bindings for Azure/Qualtran hardware models; never substitute failure probability for operator-norm error.

title: Define topology schema for hardware targets
description: §8.2 says: "gates on disjoint wires MAY overlap unless max_parallel or a topology is declared"; §8.3 lists no topology field or connectivity/placement semantics. Need physical vertices/edges, addressable class assignment and routing validation to express a superconducting 2D grid without pretending all-to-all.

title: Define eps_decade table indexing
description: §8.1 includes {"table":name,"index":"k"|"eps_decade"} but defines no eps_decade rounding/domain/offset. Mirror ISA b-isa-spec-f31; exact boundary examples required.
